changes: Represent source validation helpers once as graph vertices with exact local check sites.
Represent helper calls with lexical guards and formal/actual expression transformations.
Compute strongly connected components and retain recursive transitions instead of unfolding to a depth cutoff.
Retain unresolved fixture, callback, import binding, and source-budget boundaries explicitly.
promotion: Standalone experimental analysis only; not integrated into guarded admission or the main search method.

findings: source_complete is a graph representation flag, not computed semantic reachability, predicate truth, termination, or applicability.
Resolved validation helpers in ordinary non-test files can be classified as production and remain opaque, concealing assertions.
Unresolved value-context calls may have validation side effects that are not represented as additional check sites.
independent_preservation_review.consequence: Do not use completeness flags as validity certificates or to claim false-positive reduction. Preserve for later investigation without promotion.
